title: ResViewX: Global, Local and Directional Resolution Analysis of Cryo-EM Maps Within UCSF ChimeraX
content: Summary: ResViewX is a UCSF ChimeraX bundle that computes the global Fourier shell correlation (FSC), local resolution (MonoRes) and directional resolution (Fourier Shell Occupancy, FSO) on maps already open in the session and displays every result directly on the 3D density. A new view-dependent colouring recolours the density as the map is rotated to show how reliable the current view is.
